findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bridge_reshape, concurrent_forces, cs_stage_results, model_report_export, create_nodes, preview_result_table, stress_element_loads · Private data: auto_structure_groups, b2p_undo, bridge_reshape, concurrent_forces_setup, concurrent_forces_probe, cs454_moving_loads, cs_stage_summary, cs_stage_report, culvert_build, culvert_build_undo, dxf_inspect, dxf_import, skew_grillage, civil_read_table, model_report_images, model_report_export, model_bridge_summary, model_to_ifc, model_to_dxf, create_nodes, result_table_catalog, preview_result_table, export_result_tables · Public sink: concurrent_forces, cs_stage_results, model_report_export, create_nodes, preview_result_table, stress_element_loads · Destructive: auto_structure_groups, auto_structure_groups_undo, b2p_convert, b2p_undo, bridge_reshape, bridge_reshape_undo, concurrent_forces_setup, cs454_moving_loads, cs454_moving_loads_undo, cs455_export_calc_sheet, cs_stage_results, cs_stage_report, culvert_report, dxf_import, ec_wind_remove, skew_grillage, skew_grillage_undo, model_qc_check, model_report_export, create_nodes, create_nodes_undo, pd6694_route_a_remove, pd6694_ssi_plan, pd6694_ssi_run, pd6694_ssi_remove, export_result_tables, section_write_undo, section_read, construction_stages, stages_undo.
